question: If an income of 200 yuan is recorded as +200 yuan, how should an expenditure of 150 yuan be recorded?
solution: Income is recorded as positive. Expenditure has the opposite meaning and should be recorded as negative. Its value is 150, so it is -150 yuan.

nodes.description: Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from 0 on the number line; interpret absolute value as magnitude for a positive or negative quantity in a real-world situation.
